description: This file defines a producer processor class for handling frames within a processing pipeline, including filtering, optional transformation, and distribution to multiple consumers. It utilizes asyncio for asynchronous processing and extends a base FrameProcessor class.

classes.name: ProducerProcessor
classes.description: A processor that filters frames and distributes them to multiple consumers, with optional transformation and passthrough capabilities.

methods.name: identity_transformer(frame: Frame)
methods.description: A default async transformer function that returns the input frame unchanged.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], transformer: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[Frame]] = identity_transformer, passthrough: bool = True, )
methods.description: Initializes the ProducerProcessor with a filter, optional transformer, and passthrough flag.

methods.name: add_consumer(self)
methods.description: Adds a new consumer queue for distributing frames and returns the queue.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, applies the filter, distributes to consumers if filter passes, and optionally passes through downstream.

methods.name: _produce(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Sends the transformed frame to all registered consumer queues.
